purpose: Purely hypothetical project sensitivity; not any issuer forecast, valuation or probability
source_policy: Issuer release and SEC filing are disclosure cross-checks, not independent economic validation

reported_financial_calculations.warning: Includes conditional undrawn capacity, not all cash; excludes 2282 restricted cash

rows.classification: Supply of products; not downstream cash financing
Typically six years, can decline with third-party/research consumption

nvidia_commitment_schedule.warning: Rounded issuer schedule. No total combined with guarantees, historical equity cash, orders or capital platform target; no claim all amounts noncancellable.

definitions.cash_end: prior_cash + equity + loan_draw + revenue - variable_cash_cost - fixed_cash_cost - maintenance_cash_capex - initial_capex_payment - cash_interest - principal
definitions.cfads: revenue - variable_cash_cost - fixed_cash_cost - maintenance_cash_capex; pre-tax and before debt service
definitions.project_fcf: cfads - initial_capex_payment; excludes equity, debt, interest and principal
definitions.funding_gap: max(0,-min(month_end_cash at M0..M24)): maximum unmet funding need during the first 25 settlement periods only, before unspecified rescue financing. It is not a full-horizon funding guarantee; negative cash is not an executable operating path.
definitions.simple_payback: First zero-based index M>=acceptance at which cumulative project_fcf>=0 within M0..M72 (73 periods); reader-facing period=M+1. Undiscounted, pre-tax project cash payback excluding financing, time value and terminal value; neither NPV nor shareholder return. It does not establish an executable path where rescue funding remains unspecified.
definitions.ebit: revenue-variable_cash_cost-operating_fixed_cash_cost-initial_project_capex/72; illustrative original asset only; maintenance asset depreciation omitted
definitions.time_axis: M0 is the first full monthly settlement period (period 1), not an instantaneous investment date. M0..M72 comprises 73 periods. horizon_month=72 is the last zero-based index; cash_m12 and cash_m24 are end-of-period 13 and 25 balances. Reader-facing payback period = stored zero-based index + 1.
definitions.interest_timing: Drawdown occurs at the start of its period; full-period interest is charged on principal after that draw and before same-period principal repayment, at 10%/12. The first principal index is draw_month+13; 60 monthly principal payments are scheduled.

limitations: All project inputs invented solely to show timing; not calibrated to NVIDIA or CoreWeave.
Month-end netting can understate intra-month funding need.
Approval delay leaves original capex and service schedule fixed only if temporary liquidity is found; bridge cost is omitted, not assumed free in reality.
Acceptance delay shifts final 20 capex and operating fixed rent/costs; deposit and installation payments remain committed.
Slowdown assumes counterparties agree to move installation, drawdown and amortization without fees; not unilateral contractual rights.
Alternative financing is 60 extra equity replacing debt, not new customer revenue; dilution and required equity return not modeled.
No taxes, receivable delay, credit losses, inflation, price drift, escalation, refinance fees, discounted valuation or terminal asset value.
Income/cost levels assumed constant within each operating scenario; not a useful-life claim or estimate of GPU residual value.
Maintenance cash capex is modeled; its additional accounting depreciation is omitted because the EBIT demonstration is about original capital only.
Unlevered payback excludes loan repayment to prevent counting both initial equipment spend and financing principal as asset investment.
Depreciation never deducted in cash balance or project_fcf.
The 73-period cash observation horizon M0..M72 and the 72-month original-asset accounting depreciation assumption are distinct arbitrary inputs.

In the acceptance-delay-6/price-minus-20-percent/utilization-60-percent scenario, the first-25-period gap of USD 7.85 million is not the full-horizon gap: unreplenished cash reaches USD -20.53 million at M72 (period 73); any rescue funding and its cost remain unmodeled.
